resources.string: Search online when the map has no result (Photon, OpenStreetMap data)

Off by default. When the downloaded maps find nothing for what you type, that text and the centre of the map, rounded to about 1 km (never your exact position), are sent to a Photon server. Nothing else is sent, nothing is stored, and offline mode blocks it. Results are listed marked as online.
The address must start with https://

Online results are OpenStreetMap data (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL) served by Photon. The public server, photon.komoot.io, asks for fair use: the app sends at most one request a second and names itself in the User-Agent. If you search a lot, point this to your own Photon server.
The online search failed. Only results from the downloaded maps are shown.
Online results: © OpenStreetMap contributors, via Photon
Online search results (only if you turn that on, in the Play build) come from a Photon server, photon.komoot.io by default, and are OpenStreetMap data: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
